# Riyadh Events Hub

> Riyadh Events Hub is an event content and marketing service for organisers and brands in Riyadh and Saudi Arabia. It covers four event types — festivals and entertainment seasons, concerts and live music, exhibitions and conferences, and brand activations and launches — with written shot plans, a deliverables list agreed before every event, and work in Arabic and English.

## Services (Events & Entertainment Marketing)

- On-Ground Content Coverage: photo and film crews working to an approved, hour-by-hour shot plan per zone — key moments captured, clips published in real time with pre-agreed approvals, a wrap-up film (aftermovie) and an organised archive after closing.
- Creator Invitations & Event PR: targeted content-guest lists by category, city and interest, with invitations, RSVP follow-up, on-site hosting coordination, and posting agreements in writing before the event.
- Audience Content Campaigns: participation mechanics designed inside the event experience — challenges, hashtags and photo moments — with audience content collected together with repost rights.
- Reports & Content Archives: a complete inventory of everything published about the event (organiser, guests and audience), every figure documented from each platform's own analytics, and written recommendations for the next edition.

## Guides (on the homepages)

Practical, answer-first guides published free on the Riyadh Events Hub homepages:

- How to plan content coverage for a Riyadh event or festival — start from the programme as a map of content moments, a written deliverables list per phase (before / during / after), named roles including a real-time publisher, pre-agreed approvals, and vertical-first framing. Arabic: https://riyadheventshub.com/#guide-plan · English: https://riyadheventshub.com/en.html#guide-plan
- Inviting creators to Saudi events: permits, etiquette and practicalities — media accreditation through the organiser (requirements differ per event and venue; confirm early), what a written invitation contains, respecting venue rules and attendee privacy, hosting logistics for out-of-town creators, and why only written agreements on posting are guaranteed. General guidance only. Arabic: https://riyadheventshub.com/#guide-invite · English: https://riyadheventshub.com/en.html#guide-invite
- Measuring an event's content results: what to actually track — content inventory first, reach and views from each platform's own analytics, engagement quality (saves and shares over raw likes), audience hashtag/mention activity and UGC count, and follow-on actions such as ticketing-page visits; same definitions edition to edition. Arabic: https://riyadheventshub.com/#guide-measure · English: https://riyadheventshub.com/en.html#guide-measure
